name: Bowl with Dragons and Clouds
material: porcelain with molded and incised decoration and copper-red glaze
dimensions: Diameter: 10 cm (3 15/16 in.); Overall: 5 cm (1 15/16 in.)
summary: Fragments of bowls with unglazed foot rings and molded and incised ornament very similar to this extremely rare piece have been excavated at the early Ming dynasty site of the Hongwu palace at Nanjing.
